The relay type METI is designed specifically for directional control of the 
 over current and earth fault relay type MCGG. Each relay is provided with

Output Stage
 The regulated 
 voltage E, is applied to the primary winding of a transformer by a 
 transistor switch which is controlled by a 20 khz signal derived from the 
 40khz oscillator.
 The transformer secondary voltage is then rectified and smoothed to 
 produce the output voltage EL. The transformer provides 
 electrical isolation between the input and output.
 Figure 3 shows the arrangement of the input and output circuits of the 
 MSTZ02, six pairs of terminals are provided for output connections. As two 
 connections can be made to each terminal, up to twelve individual loads can 
 be independently connected thus avoiding having to loop the d.c. supply from 
 load to load. this facility affords increased security over the looping 
 method.
 The outputs are protected from induced impulse voltages by the voltage 
 dependent resistor RVD
 In very high security systems, it may be expedient to use two converters 
 in parallel so that, if a failure of one occurs, the d.c. supply is 
 maintained.
 Parallel connection to maintain a secure supply is freely permitted 
 because a diode D1 in each power supply will ensure that:
 No abnormal load is imposed on the other power supply if one fails.
 One power supply cannot feed back into the other.
